summary: 27-year-old Mt. Crested Butte man injured his lower leg skiing Friday afternoon on the west side of Ruby Peak with two friends and could not ski or walk out; he 'butt-scooted' ~1 mile toward Horse Ranch Park; CBSAR launched a 5-person response plus a Montrose helicopter recon (weathered out at 6:15 p.m.); four SAR members reached the pair ~10 p.m. and two stayed overnight; a morning hasty team packaged him in a toboggan with rope uphauls, skied him to the Horse Ranch Park trailhead, then ATV to the Kebler trailhead and ambulance to Gunnison Valley Hospital.
location: west side of Ruby Peak toward Horse Ranch Park
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Western State Colorado University SAR
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: article's 'Friday and Saturday, April 25-26' is internally inconsistent; 2015-04-24 was the Friday of the injury and the 2:15 p.m. SAR call (parent-resolved). WSCU SAR on standby/assist. Parent-opened run 585.
